content:
Long before the iPod era, the Sony Walkman was the go-to device for anyone wanting to soundtrack their life. Now a Duo app revives that experience for those of us who owned one — and you can pair it with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your options were limited. Most cassette players of the time were bulky and cumbersome. When Sony shrunk a dictaphone designed for reporters into the smallest possible cassette player, it quickly became a classic of its generation.

Developer Vidit Bhargava designed the app during a hackathon — and given that many attendees had never seen a real Walkman, he brought a physical one along to show what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album you want to insert into the cassette, and close it to start playing.

Bhargava says he originally built it as a demo for fun, but is now releasing it as a real app. The best reply on the X thread is an image that only anyone above a certain age will get.

What was your first music player? Share it in the comments.
